title: Quartic data cannot select the finite-strength four-point tangent

boundary.rank_defect: The K1726 quartic coefficient imposes one affine constraint on the two first-order chart velocities and is constant along the remaining null direction.
boundary.consequence: Neither the sharp floor 11/108 nor K1728's fixed-support construction determines the exact finite-strength tangent.
boundary.required_next_calculation: Extend the symmetric relative-Fisher expansion beyond t^8, compose it with second-order motion in the two-radius chart, and identify the first coefficient that varies along the null tangent before claiming a selected analytic branch.
boundary.finite_grid_role: K1733 locates and regression-tests a candidate branch and suggests which next coefficient to check; it is not the coefficient proof.

scope_guard: This is an identifiability boundary for the existing quartic expansion, not a no-go theorem against an exact finite-strength solution.
